newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 27.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Diversified British engineering group GKN Plc said that it and Brambles Industries Limited of Australia had agreed to acquire Germany's Mabeg GmbH. Mabeg will be acquired by a new German holding company owned equally by GKN and Brambles. The cash consideration is about DM 135 million (54.7 million stg).

Westpac Banking Corp Ltd will announce a major expansion of its operations in Asia later on Wednesday, The Australian newspaper reported. The Australian Financial Review reported that Westpac was expected to announce a cooperation agreement with Britain's Standard Chartered Plc, which has an extensive Middle Eastern and Asian network.

Santos Ltd said it planned to expand the Queensland portion of its Cooper Basin acreage to satisfy gas demand from emerging projects. "It is our firm intention to prove up more gas and significantly add to our reserves base," Santos commercial manager Rod Rayner told a gas industry development conference.

Mining house MIM Holdings Ltd topped the local share market turnover list on Tuesday as institutional investors took a positive view of the stock due to the rising copper price and its Ernest Henry operations.
Qantas' major regional competitor Air New Zealand Ltd is looking at an possible alliance with America's United Airlines, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Wednesday.
